title: The Audit Gate
kicker: No AI gets to grade its own work
tagline: The AI that writes a change can't approve it. A second AI checks it first.
what: The AI that writes a change doesn't get to approve it. Before anything can get in line to go live, a separate AI checks that exact change, and if it's edited afterward, it has to be checked again.
built: A gate that won't let a change get in line until a separate AI's check of it has passed
Each pass is tied to a fingerprint of that exact change, so editing it afterward cancels the pass
When it says no, it names which reviewer to run and how, so the chat can fix it and try again
Only a tiny change can skip it, and the skip has to say why
credit: Built it on top of my own tools
starring: Every AI chat that writes code for the product

making.problem: The AI that wrote a change was also the one saying it was ready, and fixes made after a review went out with no one looking again.

moment.what: The gate tells a chat when its review covered an earlier version of the code. It names the fresh review to run, so the next step is clear instead of another round of guessing.

frames.name: A second opinion
frames.says: A different AI checks the exact change. The AI that wrote it can't approve it.

frames.name: No pass, no line
frames.says: Until that check passes, the change can't get in line to go live.

frames.name: Edit it, check again
frames.says: Change it after the check and the pass no longer counts. It has to be checked again.
